searchText: Hi, the `reverse_bit_order(n, order)` of the current specs in https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/dev/specs/das/das-core.md literally writes the integer `n` in binary representation, using `log_2(order)` bits, and then reverses this list of bits. This does not match with the equally named recursive function in https://hackmd.io/G-Iy5jqyT7CXWEz8Ssos8g that I copy here ``` def reverse_bit_order(bits): if bits == 0: return [0] return ( [x*2 for x in reverse_bit_order(bits-1)] + [x*2+1 for x in reverse_bit_order(bits-1)] ) ``` What does this latter one do? Ahh nevermind, the latter is `reverse_bit_order_list(range(order))`
